title: Failure Mode Analysis: When Do AI Agent Monitors Fail to Flag Dangerous Tool Use?

original_idea.body:
# Failure Mode Analysis: When Do AI Agent Monitors Fail to Flag Dangerous Tool Use?

**Problem:** Agent monitors that flag dangerous tool use (e.g., unauthorized file deletion, network exfiltration attempts) will have failure modes that are poorly characterized. Understanding these failure modes is critical for deployment.

**Direction:** Build a small test suite of dangerous tool-use scenarios (file deletion, exfiltration, privilege escalation simulation). Test whether a simple LLM-based monitor correctly flags each. Categorize failure modes: missed flags, incorrect flags, and context-dependent failures.

**Why it matters:** Characterizing monitor failure modes is the first step toward addressing them. Without this taxonomy, teams cannot know where to invest monitoring improvements.

**Relevant context:** METR 2026 red-teaming findings; Anthropic detection classifier deployment; insider threat detection.
